brief.headline: Push laminate price from ₹1067.36/KG down toward ₹250/KG — we're paying 326.9% more than our best vendor and far above the fair market band of ₹205–305/kg.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price cut on laminate from ₹1067.36/KG to ₹250.00/KG, matching what we pay Silk Polypack.
priceAsk.target: ₹250.00/KG — saves us ₹58850 a year on this SKU.
priceAsk.basis: We pay Silk Polypack ₹250.00/KG today for the same laminate. The open-market asking band for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, with ₹250/kg typical. Import unit values for BOPET film run ₹171.60/kg. Our current ₹1067.36/KG sits 326.9% above our best price and well outside the fair market band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 days after receipt — no reason to ease unless they deliver the price target first.

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki publishes no financial figures, so we can't read how healthy or cash-tight they are. Our ₹76850 annual spend is tiny for a listed company of their scale. That means we carry little clout on our own, but it also means they won't fight hard to keep a small account. The real lever is lining up a credible second source and showing we can move volume elsewhere if the price stays this far out of line.

evidence.point: We pay them ₹1067.36/KG while Silk Polypack charges us ₹250.00/KG for the same laminate.
The open-market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate sits at ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg — judged market-fair at the top of the band.
The import unit value for BOPET film substrate is ₹171.60/kg, well below what we pay for finished laminate.
Closing the gap to our best price saves us ₹58850 a year on this one SKU.
Our total annual spend with them is only ₹76850 — a small account for a listed converter.

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant covering both film substrate and conversion; can second-source laminate sachets at scale.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, focused on pharma blister and sachet laminates; revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health score D (31/100) — a credible second source despite the score.

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Indian arm of global Amcor, known for high-end pharma laminates; premium pricing but very reliable.

risks: Huhtamaki's financials aren't public, so we're flying blind on their health and how hard we can push — lean on our purchase data and the backup sources instead of trying to read their balance sheet.
Our ₹76850 spend is tiny for them, so walking away won't hurt Huhtamaki much — the credible threat is qualifying UFLEX or Constantia and shifting future volume, not pulling this year's orders.

The 326.9% gap is so large it suggests either a different spec, a different service level, or we're simply being overcharged — confirm the SKU is truly identical to what Silk Polypack supplies before you anchor the ask at ₹250/KG.
All three named alternates are leads from public research, not qualified or priced yet — start the qualification process now so you have real options by the next negotiation cycle.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're reviewing our laminate spend and noticed we pay you ₹1067.36/KG while another vendor charges us ₹250/KG for the same item — help us understand the gap and what it would take to bring your price in line with the market band of ₹205–305/kg.
